faxes.title: STATION ENTRY NOTICE
faxes.body:
Operator {PLAYER_NAME},

Your arrival at the station has been confirmed.
You have been assigned to the position of Signal Tower Operator. Your previous experience in civilian radio communications will be required here.

This station plays an important role in maintaining Civil Harmony across the region.

Around the facility you will find notes and instructions explaining how each machine operates. Take some time to familiarize yourself with the environment.

FIRST TRANSMISSION

When you are ready, send the message:

CIVIL HARMONY TEST

Frequency: 104.6 MHz

Further instructions will follow after successful transmission.

Serve with discipline. Maintain order.

CIVIL HARMONY
